title: Terraform and Kubernetes operations
description: Review infrastructure plans, protect state and check workload health before rollout.

rules.instruction: Prepare the infrastructure plan for the intended workspace and environment. Have the owner review resource replacements, deletes and access changes before applying it.
rules.verification: Compare the plan with the intended scope and verify the workspace and expected providers. Record who accepted any destructive changes.

rules.instruction: Restrict access to Terraform state and saved plans. Treat both as sensitive artifacts even when console output suppresses secret values.
rules.verification: Review permissions, encryption and retention for the backend and any stored plans. Confirm that neither file is committed to Git or copied into public CI artifacts.

rules.instruction: Configure Kubernetes probes to distinguish startup, readiness to receive traffic and failures that require a restart.
rules.verification: In the test environment, check how the changed workload behaves during normal startup, brief dependency failure and recovery. Confirm that the probe triggers the intended traffic or restart behavior.
